footnotes.havoc_rush: Havoc counts sacks, tackles for loss, fumbles, interceptions and pass breakups. Sacks and tackles for loss both cost rushing yards in college football, so a defense that disrupts and stops the run compounds a team-rushing-under angle.
footnotes.values: Values are 2026 only. Ranks blend in 2025 by FBS games played, so early in the season a value and its rank can disagree.
